sourcePathOrIdentifier: Production MU game VPS SQL Server (Microsoft SQL Server 2014, 12.0.2000.8), database MuOnline, reached via the existing bm-sql RemoteOps bridge (D:\MU\Tools\RemoteOps\bm-sql.ps1) over SSH, login bloodmoon_observer
collector: Claude Sonnet 5, Game Data Platform Phase 2B -- Real GameBridge Read Models, Part Q validation
purpose: Validate the exact SQL query text used by each of the 10 new SqlServerGameDatabaseReader methods against real live data, for a real multi-character account, covering both the row-exists and row-missing path for every table touched.
scriptVersion: The exact single-statement, aliased SELECTs used in SqlServerGameDatabaseReader.cs (MEMB_INFO, AccountCharacter, Character, MasterSkillTree, GuildMember, the 5 ranking tables, CashShopData, warehouse, MEMB_STAT), run individually via bm-sql.ps1 query with the same WHERE predicates the real reader uses, plus a handful of COUNT(*) totals to characterize how many of the 6 live accounts populate each optional table
sanitizationNote: No password/email/IP/security-question column was ever selected. The 6 live memb___id values (teste, teste1, teste2, teste3, teste4, BMFAKE01) and character names (Lucas, aaaa, Elfa, summoner, RFRF, Trakinas, Bryan, BKZIN, 3636, aaaaa, EtheriusZ, BmFake01) are real but are QA/test-fixture identifiers, not real-player PII -- consistent with the small 6-account/12-character live population already characterized in references/game-data/sql-discovery/account-identity/. Unlike live-20260820/ (metadata-only, zero data rows), this capture DOES include real application data rows (character stats, currency balances) because Part Q's purpose is specifically to validate real data against the read models, not just schema shape.

files.name: 01-account-resolution.txt
files.content: bm-sql health + AccountCharacter.Id/Number inventory of all 6 real accounts + MEMB_INFO round-trip (memb_guid=3 <-> memb___id='teste2') validating GetAccountByMembGuidAsync

files.name: 02-account-character-slots.txt
files.content: Real GameID1..GameID10/GameIDC values for all 6 accounts, validating GetAccountCharacterSlotsAsync against every real shape: zero characters (teste4), one character (teste3/BMFAKE01/teste), a non-contiguous multi-slot account with a real gap (teste1, empty GameID4), and the richest account teste2 (5 contiguous slots)

files.name: 03-character-core-teste2.txt
files.content: Real Character rows for teste2's 5 characters, validating GetCharactersByNamesAsync and the Character.AccountID vs AccountCharacter.Id ownership consistency guard (all 5 consistent); also documents a real Experience int32 overflow observation on 4 of the 5 rows

files.name: 04-masterskilltree-guild-rankings.txt
files.content: Real MasterSkillTree (Lucas=2, others=0, all rows present), GuildMember (only Lucas, guild 'GMaster'), and whole-database ranking table row counts (all 5 tables, 0 rows each) -- validates GetMasterLevelAsync, GetGuildMembershipAsync, GetRankingsForCharacterAsync against both the row-exists and row-missing real cases

files.name: 05-cashshop-warehouse-online.txt
files.content: Real CashShopData/warehouse rows for all 4 accounts that have them (teste2's real balances: WCoinC=1007, WCoinP=998, GoblinPoint=42638, warehouse Money=59999999) and real MEMB_STAT rows for all 6 accounts (ConnectStat=0, everyone currently offline) -- validates GetCashShopBalancesAsync, GetWarehouseMoneyAsync, GetAccountOnlineStatusAsync

notes: Collected via the pre-existing, purpose-built bm-sql RemoteOps bridge -- not a new connection improvised this session, and no new network path was opened. IMPORTANT SCOPE NOTE: this evidence proves the SQL QUERY TEXT and LOGIC used by SqlServerGameDatabaseReader are correct against real live data. It does NOT prove Microsoft.Data.SqlClient physically opened a connection from the .NET Agent process to the real server -- no such connection is possible from this workstation without opening a new, unauthorized network path (D:\MU\docs\remoteops-runbook.md is explicit that SQL is reached only through bm-sql/SSH and port 1433 is never opened). See derived/real-data-validation-report.md and the Phase 2B final report's REAL_SQL_LOGIC_VALIDATED_AGAINST_LIVE_DATA vs REAL_GAMEBRIDGE_ACCOUNT_READ fields for the explicit distinction. GAME_WRITES_PERFORMED=0 -- every query here is a SELECT; the bridge and the bloodmoon_observer login both independently reject writes.
